content.text:
\
Throughout the development, please thoroughly research and contemplate, consulting more academic literature as appropriate, including recent academic literature which may add more nuanced or contradictory information - especially please regularly make good use of the findings already presented .\
\
\_ref/resilience-triple_Robust_Modem/\
\_ref/highFidelity-triple_Robust_Modem/\
\
\_appraisal/highFidelity-triple_Robust_Modem\
\
\_appraisal/highFidelity-triple_Robust_Modem/coverage.md\
\_appraisal/highFidelity-triple_Robust_Modem/research-reconciliation.md\
\
\
\
Please regularly continue, cross-check, and reconcile, implementation findings, more research, etc.\
\
A theoretical weakness should be taken seriously.\
\
A slight disadvantage, more computing, less efficiency, lower bit rate throughput, in all situations is not much of a concern, whereas a general purpose solution without breaking failure due to more drastic CPU ceiling or sensitivity loss in some situations, including merely theoretical situations, should be preferred.\
\
This is especially important for triple Robust Modem as there is not usually much computational ceiling for truly unnecessary redundant historical searching, and due to the long, slow transmission time in the challenging cases for which optimization is important, there is not a practical opportunity to communicate back from the receiver to the transmitter what the conditions are.\
\
\
The purpose of the three separate carriers of triple Robust Modem is to improve the computational feasibility of the receiver search under turbulent atmospheric and other conditions.\
\
Due to the huge variability of the doppler/delay spread, etc, and triple Robust Modem already operating near computational ceiling limits, it may be reasonable to continue allowing the GUI to bound the amount of such perturbations to search through (eg. the amount of frequency variation per the Doppler/Delay Spread and Frequency Selective Amplitude Modulation GUI dropdowns, etc).\
\
Receiver algorithm must still work under more realistic deteriorating conditions, etc, however.\
\
If doppler/delay spread is set to something like HF Worst, and frequency selective amplitude modulation something like Each 65%, but then conditions vary from the ideal of no atmospheric effects, all the way to nearly these full conditions, if the atmospheric frequency modulation applied by the real atmosphere actually randomly changes frequency, triple Robust Modem should appropriately receive the message/data bits.\
\
Such resilience should be implemented across the possible deteriorating (eg. ionospheric) conditions for different types of communications paths.\
\
\- Sub-9kHz 200ft Antenna\
\- Groundwave 1MHz\
\- Groundwave 30MHz\
\- Skywave 1-30MHz\
\- Earth-Moon-Earth\
\
Please refer to the details of the test suite and results of \_appraisal/highFidelity-triple_Robust_Modem .\
\
\
\
Preferably, as SNR decreases, or conditions deteriorate, the fundamental mathematical necessity of more time/energy required, computation getting closer to the computational ceiling of the processor, is supported with gaps, and especially the usable sensitivity or deteriorated conditions floor, is as graciously close as practical, to the smooth trends predicted by corresponding theoretical limits along these trends, to the point of the most challenging situation remaining as feasible as practical.\
\
Identifying, if needed, improvements to avoid such disproportionate tradeoffs, unnecessary pitfalls, etc, in realistic situations, was the purpose of the high-fidelity tests.\
\
\
\
\
Please use the high fidelity test suite and results, to, as practical, develop actionable generic imlementation improvements to eliminate failures.\
\
Reception under the common case of high path loss (eg. worse than 180dB), low transmission power (eg. worse than 100mW), with long transmit times (eg. worse than minutes per bit), without unnecessarily long outages due to common ionospheric vagarity, preferably not more than a few days of outage, is less of an edge case, and should be to the extent practical, particularly ensured.\
\
\
\
\
Please use the high fidelity test results and tests, etc, to implement appropriate improvements, to prevent failures, pitfalls, etc, for triple Robust Modem.\
\
\
\
\
\
RunPod GPUs remain available. Please deploy RunPod instances, upload, etc, as reasonably needed, preferably keeping upload times less than a few minutes, building and caching on RunPod cheap persistent volumes if uploads get much larger than a few hundred megabytes and thus slower, etc.\
\
The limits on RunPod hours and budget are somewhat relaxed for this work. Although being able to run such tests reasonably quickly in future testing remains important, up to 8hours and $20 per hour spend on RunPod usage is reasonable for this work.\

Wrong-key admissions have been significantly mitigated already by operator configurable filtering of messages/data in the signal browser. If such interference is a serious cause of received bits that should not have been received, then the operator can quickly determine that.

For moderate amounts of filtering, only require a few dB of sensitivity loss is necessary anyway. Realistically, such interference would be extremely rare absence the sort of telecommunications outage that could justify extra operator attention, more noticeable interference at 20dB higher transmit power, etc.

Moreover, wrong bit admissions should never have been regarded as particularly serious also because if only a few dB of sensitivity loss was needed to mitigate such a pitfall then, especially through an operator configurable GUI widget, that would be an acceptable tradeoff.

Usually, general purpose resilience under all conditions, especially all less predictable or controllable natural conditions - lower SNR, atmospheric deterioration, computational ceiling, etc - is worth at least just a few dB of sensitivity loss or some other such mild tradeoff against a relative pitfall.


Preferably, as SNR decreases, or conditions deteriorate, the fundamental mathematical necessity of more time/energy required, computation getting closer to the computational ceiling of the processor, is supported with gaps, and especially the usable sensitivity or deteriorated conditions floor, is as graciously close as practical, to the smooth trends predicted by corresponding theoretical limits along these trends, to the point of the most challenging situation remaining as feasible as practical.

General purpose resilience is the more important consideration amongst tradeoffs.



Please use the high fidelity test results and tests, etc, to implement appropriate improvements, to prevent failures, pitfalls, etc, for triple Robust Modem.
